scripts.db:migrate: bash -c 'export MIKU_DATABASE=dev CHECKPOINT_DISABLE=1; prisma migrate dev "$@" && prisma generate' --
scripts.start: CHECKPOINT_DISABLE=1 prisma migrate deploy && tsx src/index.ts
scripts.dev: export MIKU_DATABASE=dev PORT=4751 MIKU_BACKUPS=off MIKU_REFRESH=off CHECKPOINT_DISABLE=1; prisma migrate deploy && tsx watch src/index.ts
scripts.refresh: CHECKPOINT_DISABLE=1 prisma migrate deploy >/dev/null && tsx scripts/refresh.ts
